verdict.rationale: Qualcomm documents a Hexagon NPU rated at up to 85 TOPS, but its spec page explicitly omits the precision, which the story requires. It also documents official developer tooling that targets the Hexagon NPU on Snapdragon X-series PCs and is available now: Qualcomm AI Engine Direct SDK, AI Hub, Qualcomm AI Runtime, and the GenieX unified runtime. missing for 10: precision stated alongside the TOPS figure, explicit confirmation that the SDK/runtime supports X2 Elite Extreme specifically, independent or hands-on corroboration of NPU access via the SDK.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the chip's AI acceleration is exposed to developers — an NPU or neural engine with a published TOPS figure (precision stated) and an official SDK or runtime that ships today
